sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, ad.AddOnProductId AS addOnProductId, ad.AddOnName AS addOnName, gp.RetailPrice AS price, gp.SalesPrice AS salesPrice, MAX(cpt.val) AS categoryPath, MAX(br.brandName) AS brandName, MAX(sd.val) AS shortDescription, MAX(tr.q1) AS tier1Qty, MAX(tr.tp1) AS tier1Price, MAX(tr.q2) AS tier2Qty, MAX(tr.tp2) AS tier2Price, MAX(tr.q3) AS tier3Qty, MAX(tr.tp3) AS tier3Price, MAX(al.anm1) AS addOn1Name, MAX(al.apr1) AS addOn1Price, MAX(al.anm2) AS addOn2Name, MAX(al.apr2) AS addOn2Price, MAX(al.anm3) AS addOn3Name, MAX(al.apr3) AS addOn3Price, MAX(al.aid2) AS addOn2ProductId, MAX(al.aid3) AS addOn3ProductId, MAX(agn.nm) AS addOnGroupName, MAX(inv1.v) AS warehouseInventory, MAX(tb.ld) AS details, MAX(tb.sp) AS specifications, MAX(tb.sh) AS shippingInfo, MAX(po.InStockMsg) AS inStockMessage FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = p.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pr.RetailPrice, pr.SalesPrice, pr.PriceListId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 a.PimProductId AS AddOnProductId, a.ProductName AS AddOnName FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct a ON a.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = a.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType AND a.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType AND rq.PimAddOnProductId <> ap.PimAddOnProductId) AND (SELECT TOP 1 apr.RetailPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId = apr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplo ON aplo.PriceListId = apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU = a.SKU AND aplo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY aplo.Precedence, apl.PriceListId, apr.PriceId) > @minPrice GROUP BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, a.PimProductId, a.ProductName HAVING MAX(ai.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, a.PimProductId) ad OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT_WS(@pathSep, g4.Name, g3.Name, g2.Name, g1.Name) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ke INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity kv ON kv.VersionId = ke.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog kc ON kc.PublishCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g1 ON g1.VersionId = ke.VersionId AND g1.ZnodeCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId AND g1.LocaleId = ke.LocaleId AND g1.Name = ke.CategoryName AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, g1.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, ke.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h1 ON h1.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g1.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g2 ON g2.VersionId = g1.VersionId AND g2.LocaleId = g1.LocaleId AND g2.ZnodeCatalogId = g1.ZnodeCatalogId AND g2.ZnodeCategoryId = h1.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h2 ON h2.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g2.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g3 ON g3.VersionId = g2.VersionId AND g3.LocaleId = g2.LocaleId AND g3.ZnodeCatalogId = g2.ZnodeCatalogId AND g3.ZnodeCategoryId = h2.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h3 ON h3.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g3.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g4 ON g4.VersionId = g3.VersionId AND g4.LocaleId = g3.LocaleId AND g4.ZnodeCatalogId = g3.ZnodeCatalogId AND g4.ZnodeCategoryId = h3.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId WHERE ke.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND kc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND kv.RevisionType = @publishState AND kv.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND ke.IsActive = @isActive AND ke.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND ke.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY ke.VersionId DESC, ke.ProductIndex, ke.PublishProductEntityId, g1.ZnodeCategoryId) cpt OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(sta.AttributeValue, sal.AttributeValue) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute spa ON spa.PimAttributeId = sav.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue sta ON sta.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sta.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale sal ON sal.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sal.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE sav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND spa.AttributeCode = @shortDescriptionCode ORDER BY sav.PimAttributeValueId) sd OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q3, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp3 FROM (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.Quantity, t.PriceTierId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = gp.PriceListId AND t.SKU = p.SKU) tq) tr OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm1, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr1, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm3, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr3, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.id END) AS aid2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.id END) AS aid3 FROM (SELECT ao.PimProductId AS id, ao.ProductName AS nm, MAX(apx.price) AS pr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, ao.PimProductId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(xr.SalesPrice, xr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice xr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList xl ON xl.PriceListId = xr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal xo ON xo.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId WHERE xr.SKU = ao.SKU AND xo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND xr.RetailPrice > @zero AND (xl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (xr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY xo.Precedence, xl.PriceListId, xr.PriceId) apx WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType GROUP BY ao.PimProductId, ao.ProductName, ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder) ax) al OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 gl.AddonGroupName AS nm FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroupLocale gl ON gl.PimAddonGroupId = g.PimAddonGroupId AND gl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, ap.PimAddOnProductId) agn OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(wh.WarehouseName, @pairSep, CAST(iv.Quantity AS BIGINT)), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, aw.Precedence, aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory iv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeWarehouse wh ON wh.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse dw ON dw.PortalId = po.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse aw ON aw.PortalWarehouseId = dw.PortalWarehouseId AND aw.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId WHERE iv.SKU = p.SKU AND (iv.WarehouseId = dw.WarehouseId OR aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NOT NULL)) inv1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @detailsCode THEN tx.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @specificationsCode THEN tx.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN tx.v END) AS sh FROM (SELECT ta.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(tt.AttributeValue, tl.AttributeValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue tv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ta ON ta.PimAttributeId = tv.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue tt ON tt.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tt.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale tl ON tl.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE tv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ta.AttributeCode IN (@detailsCode, @specificationsCode, @shippingInfoCode)) tx) tb WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND po.StoreCode = @store AND gp.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) <= @maxRequiredAddOns AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) GROUP BY p.SKU, p.ProductName, ad.AddOnProductId, ad.AddOnName, gp.RetailPrice, gp.SalesPrice HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY p.SKU
